Inside the tool xAI built to make searching any topic look like this
caption:
xAI just shipped Grokipedia v0.3, and the visual upgrade makes it look like a different product entirely.

Grokipedia is xAI's AI-powered encyclopedia. You search any topic and instead of a list of links, you get a structured, visual breakdown of it. V0.3 makes those visuals sharper and more detailed across the board.

It's live inside Grok right now.
